endorsements.name: dotAero
endorsements.label: The Paparazzi Platform: Flexible, Open-Source, UAS Software and Hardware
endorsements.description: This presentation introduces the Paparazzi framework, an Open-Source (GPL3 and OSHW CC-by-SA) software and hardware robotics platform focused on Unmanned Aerial Systems (UASes). Paparazzi’s power and flexibility enable rapid development and robust control of diverse vehicle types – from fixed-wing airplanes to multicopters and transitioning aircraft – while its open nature permit customization and integration with other systems. We show the capabilities of the platform and some achievements from all around the world with this platform. We also will show what we are working on and introduce it to the public. What will you do with that powerful tool? The Paparazzi autopilots, a multicopter, and the Quadshot – a VTOL, multirotor, transitioning flying wing – are presented.
